titleText: Food safety warning over undeclared mustard in organic soba noodles
mainText: From Times of Malta: Food safety warning over undeclared mustard in organic soba noodles. Consumers allergic or intolerant to mustard advised not to consume affected batch of Hakubaku noodles

titleText: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears
mainText: From The Malta Independent: International arrest warrant issued for ex-Steward Health Care boss Ralph de la Torre, court hears. Maltese authorities have issued an international arrest warrant for Ralph de la Torre, the former Steward Health Care chief who has yet to turn up to face charges over the hospitals deal.

titleText: Ten new social housing apartments to be built in Paola
mainText: From Times of Malta: Ten new social housing apartments to be built in Paola. Two projects represent a combined investment of around €900,000

titleText: BCA seeks withdrawal of KTP directive following understanding on key construction regulation changes
mainText: From The Malta Independent: BCA seeks withdrawal of KTP directive following understanding on key construction regulation changes. The Building and Construction Authority (BCA) is seeking the withdrawal of a directive issued by the Kamra tal-Periti (KTP), after the two sides reached a preliminary understanding on proposed changes to construction regulations concerning architects' professional responsibilities and liability.

titleText: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says
mainText: From MaltaToday: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says. Reinstatement works on a section of Triq tal-Qares in Mosta are expected to begin in the coming days, Enemalta has said, following delays by the private contractor engaged to carry them out.
